items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to gain elevated access to sensitive resources and hijack customer accounts.

items.title: Security updates available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released security updates resolving critical and important vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover, in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could lead to arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (B2B)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass in Adobe Commerce, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Security updates available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, addressing critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie without authentication or admin privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Auth Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the application without user interaction.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API, dubbed PolyShell, that enables unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store by bypassing validation with a polyglot file.
